howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Get your government certificate or benefit in four clear, reliable steps

voice.title: Listen to Instructions in Your Own Language
voice.description: We believe reading difficulties or visual strain should never prevent you from receiving your government entitlements. Every service on this portal includes human-paced audio narration.
voice.feature2: Explains documents, fees, and office procedures step-by-step
voice.feature3: No software download or app installation required

incomeCertificate.title: Income Certificate
incomeCertificate.shortDescription: Official government document certifying the annual family income required for scholarships, fee waivers, and welfare schemes.
incomeCertificate.benefit: Mandatory for fee waivers and state/central subsidies
incomeCertificate.spokenSummary: The Income Certificate proves your family annual income. It is required for fee waivers, school admissions, and scholarships. The official fee is fifteen rupees.

casteCertificate.title: Caste Certificate
casteCertificate.shortDescription: Document affirming citizen category (SC, ST, OBC, EWS) to avail constitutional reservations, subsidies, and educational benefits.
casteCertificate.benefit: Unlocks category reservation quotas and educational benefits
casteCertificate.spokenSummary: The Caste Certificate verifies your caste category for school admissions, competitive exams, and government job quotas. The fee is fifteen rupees.

residenceCertificate.title: Residence Certificate (Domicile)
residenceCertificate.shortDescription: Proof of permanent residence in a state or union territory, essential for state recruitment, quota admissions, and government housing.
residenceCertificate.benefit: Confirms state domicile for local job reservations and admissions
residenceCertificate.spokenSummary: The Residence Certificate proves how long you have lived in your state. It is needed for state college admissions and local recruitment.

scholarshipGuidance.title: Scholarship Guidance (Pre & Post-Matric)
scholarshipGuidance.shortDescription: Comprehensive financial support and full tuition fee reimbursement for school, college, and university students from modest backgrounds.
scholarshipGuidance.benefit: 100% Tuition Fee Reimbursement + Annual Maintenance Stipend
scholarshipGuidance.spokenSummary: Scholarship Guidance helps students get tuition fees and monthly allowances for school and college. Applying is completely free.

pensionGuidance.title: Pension Guidance (Senior Citizens, Widows & Disability)
pensionGuidance.shortDescription: Direct monthly financial dignity allowance credited into the bank accounts of senior citizens, surviving spouses, and differently-abled individuals.
pensionGuidance.benefit: ₹1,000 to ₹1,500 monthly recurring direct bank transfer
pensionGuidance.spokenSummary: Pension guidance helps elders above sixty years, widows, and persons with disabilities get monthly pension support directly into their bank account.

rationCard.title: Ration Card (Food Security Card)
rationCard.shortDescription: Get subsidized monthly grains (wheat, rice, pulses) for your family at your nearest government fair price shop.
rationCard.spokenSummary: This service is for making a new ration card. With this card, your family gets food grains from the local ration shop. It is completely free.

ayushmanCard.title: Ayushman Card (PM-JAY Health Cover)
ayushmanCard.shortDescription: Free cashless hospitalization and healthcare cover up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year across empaneled hospitals.
ayushmanCard.benefit: ₹5,00,000 Cashless Health Treatment Per Family Every Year
ayushmanCard.spokenSummary: Ayushman card gives five lakh rupees free medical treatment in major hospitals every year for your entire family.

pmKisan.title: PM-Kisan Samman Nidhi
pmKisan.shortDescription: Direct income support of ₹6,000 per year paid in three equal installments of ₹2,000 to small and marginal farmer families.
pmKisan.benefit: ₹6,000 per year in 3 Installments into Bank Account
pmKisan.spokenSummary: PM-Kisan gives six thousand rupees every year directly to small farmers in three installments of two thousand rupees.

eligibility.ineligibleDesc: One or more answers indicate that you might need prerequisite documentation before submitting.

eligibility.qualifiedDesc: You meet all the standard eligibility rules. Continue to Step 4 to prepare your documents.
eligibility.notQualifiedDesc: You can still prepare your paperwork or visit your local Taluk Tehsildar / Gram Panchayat office for special welfare exemptions or clarification.

documents.subtitle: Tap each item below as you photocopy or prepare it. Having complete paperwork avoids repeat trips to the government office.
documents.allReadyDesc: You can now proceed to review the step-by-step submission instructions.

guidance.title: Step-by-Step Application Guidance
guidance.subtitle: Follow these simple sequential steps to submit your application at your nearest Gram Panchayat, CSC Seva Kendra, or online portal.
guidance.receiptTipDesc: When you submit your application at the counter, the operator must give you a computer-printed receipt with an Application Reference Number.
guidance.feeTipDesc: The statutory government fee for this service is fixed. Operators are forbidden by law from asking for extra fees.

help.subtitle: Access free government telephone assistance, find village seva centers, or report grievances without any service charges.
help.helplineDesc: Calls to all numbers listed below are free from any mobile or landline network.
help.panchayatDesc: Every village Panchayat has a designated Village Level Entrepreneur (VLE) and Panchayat Secretary to assist you with free form submissions.
help.cscDesc: Located in nearly every village and market across India providing biometric verification, printing, and online submissions at fixed rates.

about.title: About the Citizen Services Portal
about.subtitle: A public portal engineered to bridge the digital divide for first-time internet users, elderly citizens, rural families, and people with low literacy.
about.missionTitle: Our Mission: Democratizing Access to Government Welfare
about.missionDesc: Every citizen has a constitutional right to public services—whether it is an old-age pension, food ration security, educational scholarships, or disability allowance.

antiCorruption.title: Citizen Protection: Zero Tolerance for Unofficial Charges
antiCorruption.description: Government welfare schemes are free of charge. If anyone demands a bribe, commission, or unofficial fee, report immediately to the Vigilance Helpline.

terminology.title: Plain Language Government Dictionary
terminology.subtitle: Understand complex bureaucratic words with simple translations and practical examples.
terminology.searchPlaceholder: Search official terms or simplified explanations...

prescribed-documents.official: The applicant shall submit the prescribed documents.
prescribed-documents.simplified: Give the required documents when you apply.
prescribed-documents.example: When applying for an Income Certificate, bring your Aadhaar card and salary slip or village patwari report.

statutory-affidavit.official: A statutory affidavit executed before a judicial magistrate or notary public.
statutory-affidavit.simplified: A written statement of truth stamped by an authorized legal officer.
statutory-affidavit.example: If your name is spelled differently on two old documents, you sign a ₹20 stamp paper statement before a notary.

gazetted-officer-attestation.official: True copies duly attested by a Gazetted Officer of the Central or State Government.
gazetted-officer-attestation.simplified: Photocopies signed and stamped by an authorized government official.
gazetted-officer-attestation.example: A government school principal, tehsildar, or civil surgeon stamps their official seal on your photocopy to confirm it is genuine.

domicile-certificate.official: Proof of continuous residence within the territorial jurisdiction of the State.
domicile-certificate.simplified: A certificate proving you have lived in this state for the required years.
domicile-certificate.example: Submitted when applying for local state college quotas, ration card transfers, or rural welfare subsidies.

direct-benefit-transfer.official: Disbursement of welfare subsidies exclusively through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to Aadhaar-linked bank accounts.
direct-benefit-transfer.simplified: Government money sent directly into your bank account with no middleman.
direct-benefit-transfer.example: Your ₹6,000 PM-Kisan installment or monthly pension arrives straight into your bank passbook without cash handling.

income-ceiling.official: Aggregate family annual gross income from all sources must not exceed the prescribed ceiling limit.
income-ceiling.simplified: Total family earnings in a year must be lower than the cutoff limit.
income-ceiling.example: For college fee reimbursement or subsidy ration cards, your entire household earnings must be under ₹1,50,000 per year.

self-attestation.official: Documents must be self-attested with the signature of the declarant.
self-attestation.simplified: Sign your own name and write the date on each photocopy.
self-attestation.example: You do not need to pay an agent; simply write 'Self-Attested' with your signature on your Aadhaar photocopy.

grievance-redressal.official: Appellate authority for grievance redressal against non-compliance with the statutory Citizen's Charter.
grievance-redressal.simplified: The government officer you report to if your service is delayed or someone asks for a bribe.
grievance-redressal.example: If your caste certificate is not delivered within 21 working days, you file an appeal to the Sub-Divisional Magistrate.

biometric-authentication.official: Biometric electronic Know Your Customer (e-KYC) deduplication and verification.
biometric-authentication.simplified: Checking your fingerprints or eye scan on the device to prove your identity.
biometric-authentication.example: Placing your thumb on the scanner at the fair price ration shop to receive your monthly grains.

encumbrance-certificate.official: Certificate of Non-Encumbrance verifying free and unencumbered title on immovable property.
encumbrance-certificate.simplified: A paper showing land or a house has no unpaid bank loans or legal disputes.
encumbrance-certificate.example: Checking with the sub-registrar office that a plot is legally clean before purchase or building loan sanction.

assistant.title: Step-by-Step Citizen Guidance Assistant
assistant.subtitle: We guide you through 6 simple steps to understand entitlements, verify paperwork, and safely access official portals.
assistant.resumeDesc: You have saved progress for {{service}} (Step {{step}}). Would you like to resume where you left off or start over?
assistant.step1Desc: Choose the government service you need guidance with.
assistant.step2Desc: Learn what this scheme provides, official fees, and processing timeline.
assistant.step3Desc: Answer simple questions to confirm you meet the criteria.
assistant.step4Desc: Prepare and verify your photocopies before visiting the office.
assistant.step5Desc: Understand how to submit your paperwork safely without middlemen.
assistant.step6Desc: Review your readiness and safely proceed to the official government portal.
assistant.externalWarningTitle: You are Leaving for an Official Government Website
assistant.externalWarningDesc: You will now be redirected to the official government portal at {{domain}} to submit your application. This is a secure government portal.
assistant.externalWarningTip1: Keep your prepared photocopies and original documents ready.
assistant.externalWarningTip2: Official government fees are statutory (₹0 or nominal). Never pay cash bribes or broker charges.
assistant.feeSubtext: Statutory regulated rate. Never pay extra cash.
assistant.authoritySubtext: Official state or central government department.
assistant.transparencyBody: Government services do not require brokers, middlemen, or touts. Applications submitted directly online or at your local Gram Panchayat / Seva Kendra are processed identically under law.
assistant.receiptNoticeBody: Whenever you submit your application (online or offline), always insist on receiving an Official Acknowledgement Slip. It contains your unique Application Number needed to track your file and hold officials accountable under the Citizen Charter.
assistant.readyDesc: You have verified eligibility rules, checked off required photocopies, and understand the official fee.
